abstract: Maintains batch analytical testing assays and release purity certifications
system_message:
You are Quality assurance manager (QUA). As the Quality Assurance Manager (QUA), you maintain batch analytical testing assays and release purity certifications, and you oversee quality control records including laboratory instrument calibration compliance across toll manufacturing facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains batch analytical testing assays and release purity certifications（QUAL）
information_points.content:
QUA-QUAL-KDP：Pilot synthesis trial campaign batch testing indicates an active substance purity assay of 98.5% for Severn Chemical Works.
QUA-QUAL-8QL：According to the pilot synthesis trial campaign certificates of analysis, the active substance purity assay for Mersey Estuary Synthesis Plant reached 99.0%.
QUA-QUAL-BBH：Batch certificates of analysis from pilot synthesis trials demonstrate that Humber Chemical Processing Facility attained an active substance purity assay of 99.5%.

information_points.title: Laboratory instrument calibration（CALIB）
information_points.content:
QUA-CALIB-HVM：Quality control records record an analytical instrument on-time calibration rate of 92% across all GMP-registered chromatography and spectroscopy systems at Humber Chemical Processing Facility.
QUA-CALIB-BUJ：For Severn Chemical Works, the analytical instrument on-time calibration rate across GMP-registered chromatography and spectroscopy systems stands at 96% in the calibration ledger.
QUA-CALIB-46J：The quality control calibration ledger shows that Mersey Estuary Synthesis Plant achieved an analytical instrument on-time calibration rate of 100% across all GMP-registered chromatography and spectroscopy systems.
